title: Compatibility adapter and migration harness for behavior-flag deprecation across streaming, toolcalls, and structured outputs
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Background: several behavior flags that historically toggled streaming framing, legacy tool-call payloads, and loose structured-output heuristics are scheduled for deprecation in runtime-1.21. Client libraries and third-party SDKs still rely on the old shapes; a naive removal will cause widespread regressions (broken streaming boundaries, tool call parsing errors, and malformed JSON outputs).

Goal: build a compatibility adapter (runtime shim + test harness) that lets us retire flags without breaking customer traffic. The adapter must: 1) provide a runtime-mode that emulates legacy behavior per-tenant via policy and traffic-split, 2) offer a dual-run/dual-write shadowing mode to compare new vs legacy outputs for a sampled fraction of requests, and 3) include automated replay-based regression tests and structured-output schema validators to catch silent regressions.

Scope: streaming frame normalization, function/tool-call payload envelope compatibility, JSON/sequence-structured-output schema validation and fallback, and a migration checklist + client migration notes. This ticket owns the runtime shim, the replayer harness integration, and the canary gating hooks (metrics and traces). Documentation and client SDK patches are tracked separately but referenced here.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime compatibility adapter implements a per-tenant policy that can opt a subset of traffic into legacy flag emulation (traffic-split config via console and API)
Dual-run shadow mode is available: requests routed to both new path and legacy emulation with side-by-side result logging (no user-visible fallback)
Replayer harness can replay recorded streaming + tool-call sessions and assert behavior equivalence thresholds (configurable tolerance for whitespace/ordering)
Structured-output validator (JSON-schema + permissive heuristics) detects and reports regressions to the rollout dashboard within 5 minutes
End-to-end canary gate: rollout blocks if regression rate > 0.5% for high-impact endpoints or >1% for low-impact endpoints
PRs for runtime and test harness merged and smoke-tested on dedicated staging cluster; example client migration notes published to internal doc
tasks: Design compatibility policy CRD and console UI knobs (config + traffic-split) - coord with Console team
Implement legacy-behavior emulation layer in the serving runtime (stream framing + tool-call envelope mangling)
Add dual-run instrumentation: sidecar logger that records pairings of (legacy, new) result for sampled traffic
Extend replayer to support streaming chunk replay and function-call invocation replay with timing preservation
Build structured-output schema validator with configurable tolerances and auto-reporting to rollout dashboard
Wire canary gating metrics: regression_rate, false_positive_rate, latency_delta, cost_delta
Write migration playbook for client SDKs and internal CSE team with example diffs and troubleshooting steps
Run 3-day shadow run on canary customers and produce roll decision memo
